steps.name: Product Triage
steps.instructions: Assess whether this report is a real, clear, non-duplicate problem worth solving.

steps.name: Research
steps.instructions: Investigate the existing code, architecture, and UX context before proposing a solution.

steps.name: Plan Review
steps.instructions: Independent review of the PRD: sound, right-sized, sufficient acceptance criteria?

steps.name: Implement
steps.instructions: Write the code in an isolated worktree, minimal diff, with tests.

steps.name: Verify (lint/test/build)
steps.instructions: Automated lint, unit tests, typecheck, and build must all pass.

steps.name: Browser QA
steps.instructions: Drive a real browser against the running app and check the acceptance criteria.

steps.name: Code Review
steps.instructions: Independent, adversarial review for correctness, security, and regressions.
